Cost: 1,000eb (Very Expensive) for 1

Ammo Types Available: Grenades

This innovative device fools automated defenses with electronic warfare tech typically seen in jet fighters.

Grenade Ammunition. Cannot be loaded into a Grenade Launcher. When thrown, it hovers in midair above the 2x2m/yds square it would’ve normally landed on. For the next 15 seconds (5 Rounds), it emits a powerful signal in a 10x10m/yds (5x5 squares) area centered on itself.

Drones not being directly controlled by a Netrunner (or any other user) that start their Turn within this area or move through it during their Turn must beat a DV21 Concentration Check (using their Combat Number) to not be affected by the emitted signal.

Affected Drones prioritize eliminating/observing this ammunition over all other targets which have not attacked or engaged the affected Drone since the end of its last Turn. This lasts until the signal's duration expires, upon which this grenade falls to the ground harmlessly and is considered Destroyed Beyond Repair.

Stack: 1

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Ammunition).
